name: NOZOKI-ma II ~Joshikousei Chijoku no Angle~
original_name: NOZOKI魔II～女子校生恥辱のアングル～
source:
Main character has a hobby of peeping. But older women don't excite him, so he chooses school girls as prey. He chooses girl dormitory to peep at girls and young female teachers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
